resources.string: Keep YouTube audio playing with the screen off. Grant access once, add the Quick Settings tile, then tap it while a video plays.

This PoC needs the permissions below to read the YouTube notification title, play audio in the background, and survive with the screen off.

1. Notification access (read YouTube title)
2. Post notifications (media playback FGS)
3. Unrestricted battery (screen-off reliability)
4. Add the Quick Settings tile
5. Play YouTube, then tap the tile
Tip: play a YouTube video, pull down Quick Settings, then tap Background Stream.
On this Android version, edit Quick Settings manually and add \"Background Stream\".
Tile add prompt shown (or already added).
